description: This Java class is a builder for creating and manipulating DittoHeaders objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides fluent API methods for constructing headers, initializing from existing headers or JSON objects, and producing immutable headers objects.

classes.name: DefaultDittoHeadersBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class with a fluent API for creating per-instance DittoHeaders, enabling construction with initial properties, from existing headers, or from JSON objects.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance initialized with an empty header map.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance initialized with the provided header map.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance initialized with properties from the given JsonObject.

methods.name: getEmptyHeaders
methods.description: Returns an immutable empty DittoHeaders instance.

methods.name: doBuild
methods.description: Returns the provided DittoHeaders as the result of the build process.
